He forgave them while they were crucifying him. ✝️ Luke 23

At Calvary, between two criminals, Jesus prayed: “Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do” (Luke 23:34). To the thief who asked to be remembered, he said: “To day shalt thou be with me in paradise” (Luke 23:43). Then: “It is finished” (John 19:30).

Who do you need to forgive this week? Type “FORGIVEN” if his grace reached you 👇

She prayed so hard, the priest thought she was drunk. 🙏 1 Samuel 1

Hannah had no children, and year after year she was provoked until she wept and did not eat. At Shiloh she prayed so deeply that “only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard” (1 Samuel 1:13). Her answer to Eli: “I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the Lord” (1 Samuel 1:15). Later: “For this child I prayed” (1 Samuel 1:27).

What are you praying for right now? Drop a 🙏 and we'll pray with you in our quiet time 👇

She was talking to Jesus and thought he was the gardener. 🌅 John 20

Early on the first day of the week, “when it was yet dark,” Mary Magdalene found the stone taken away (John 20:1). Weeping outside the empty tomb, she saw Jesus, “supposing him to be the gardener” (John 20:15). Then he said one word: “Mary.” And she answered, “Rabboni” (John 20:16).

He is risen, and he knows your name. Type “RISEN” if you believe it 👇

The oil kept flowing until she ran out of jars. 🏺 2 Kings 4

A widow was about to lose her two sons to a creditor. All she had was “a pot of oil” (2 Kings 4:2). Elisha told her: “borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few” (2 Kings 4:3). She poured until “there is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed” (2 Kings 4:6).

What empty place are you bringing to God this week? 👇
